item.title: Cyber incident hits grocery stores in US, Netherlands and Belgium
item.description: Ahold Delhaize, the Dutch multinational retailer, announced it was taking precautionary measures following a cybersecurity incident, with stores in the U.S., Netherlands and Belgium reportedly impacted.

item.title: Ukraine strikes third Yandex data center, disrupting digital services across Russia
item.description: A third Yandex data center in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones over the weekend, forcing it to shut down and causing further disruptions to cloud services, payments, deliveries and other online services across the country.

item.title: Cyberattack disrupts refrigeration at hundreds of French supermarkets
item.description: A cyberattack overnight Sunday disrupted refrigerators at hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling fresh food at stores run by some of the country’s largest grocery chains.

item.title: Japan confirms arrest of Russian Qilin operative, extradition to Germany
item.description: Japan’s National Police Agency confirmed the arrest and extradition to Germany of a Russian national accused of being involved in the Qilin ransomware gang.

item.title: Hundreds of thousands impacted by data breach at biosensor firm iRhythm
item.description: A company known for wearable cardiac sensors, iRhythm, has begun notifying states of the impact of a data breach from the summer.
